get.description: Returns every capability key the product DECLARES, with its place axis, whether the responsibility axis applies, its function cluster, and whether it is that cluster's admin key. This is the declared vocabulary, NOT what is enforced today: the customers:, orders: and finance: keys are inert until their own domain epics build enforcement. Keys only — human labels live in each app, and this surface has no locale to speak. Identical for every tenant, complete in one response, never paginated.

get.description: Returns one waybill: its code, order code, status, recipient, sender, money fields, note and timestamps. Money is an exact decimal string. The key's owner needs a waybill read key for the waybill's store. An unknown code, another tenant's code and a waybill the owner cannot read all return the same 404. Responses are never cached.

post.description: Returns a link to a waybill's 100 × 150 mm shipping label PDF, found by the waybill code. The link opens without a key and stops working after five minutes; asking again returns a fresh one. The key's owner needs a waybill read key for the waybill's store. A blank code, an unknown code, another tenant's code, and a waybill the owner cannot read all return the same 404. Responses are never cached. The optional body lists up to four extra fields the 100 × 150 mm shipping label prints between the goods and the COD, each whitespace run as one space. They are signed into the link and never stored. A body that is not a JSON object, has an unknown key, or breaks a limit returns 400 and no link.

get.description: Returns a membership's role grants, grouped tenant-wide vs. per store, each grant carrying its role's status and the capabilities a store pin does NOT confine. Reading someone else's grants requires owner or iam:admin — not iam:members:view. A caller without it gets the same 404 as a membership id that does not exist, so a refusal cannot be told from a miss; an empty result is never a refusal. Only the caller's own permissions carry effectiveCapabilities. Responses are never cached.

parameters.description: Membership UUID — the id GET /api/members returns. Or the literal 'me' for the caller's own membership.

effectiveCapabilities.description: Capability keys actually in effect, with each held '<domain>:admin' already folded over its cluster. Only the caller's own permissions can carry this: every resolver takes its subject from the authenticated user, so no read resolves another member's capabilities. Null means NOT RESOLVABLE HERE — never 'this member holds nothing'. Their grants and what each granted role declares are returned regardless.
